verdict.rationale: Angular's docs say it is a fully featured platform with first-party modules for routing where everything works together. Community users corroborate this, praising the built-in @angular/router. One old report says the Angular 2 beta router lacked features such as passing data to child routes and checking the active route; that concerns an early beta's depth and does not contradict the router being official or integrated. missing for 10: in-depth first-party routing documentation (only a homepage mention), current hands-on evidence of seamless integration beyond the dated beta-era critique.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party routing library that integrates seamlessly with the framework

citations.quote: Fully featured platform where everything works together with Angular's first-party modules for forms, routing, and more
